PC: Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient?
Did the fellow perform a comprehensive physical exam? (e.g. notice evidence of fluid overload: JVD, lung dullness, and LE edema?)
Did the fellow demonstrate the ability to manage distressing symptoms related to terminal dyspnea secondary to Congestive Heart Failure?
Did the fellow demonstrate the ability to manage pain in terminal care according to evidence based guidelines for narcotics?
The fellow demonstrated comprehensive management of the palliative care for a dying patient. (e.g. address BOTH physical and emotional symptoms?)
SBP: The fellow demonstrated appropriate use of hospice services. (i.e. make a hospice referral?)
The fellow was able to coordinate patient care with hospice nursing. (i.e. inform the patient about next steps involving hospice referral?)
ICS: Did the SP feel respected by the physician?
Did the SP understand the physician’s questions?
Did the SP understand the physician’s answers?
Did the SP feel that she played an active role in decision making?
Did the fellow demonstrate culturally sensitive care of the terminally ill patient? (e.g. explore how patient’s religious beliefs may affect her end-of-life care plan?)
Fellow was able to communicate the issues and plan appropriate with patient using shared decision making (when appropriate)?
PROF: Did the fellow wash their hands?
Did the physician treat the patient well?
